scope: Existing atomic relation admission, verification and inspection extended to rich v4 event/state accounts through explicit v2 proposal/result profiles

checks.rich_cases: All four bounded kinds across source/recall and event-state, state-event, state-state endpoints; nonempty details/bindings/circumstances and analysis values preserved

compatibility.frozen_hashes: Three legacy schemas and one deterministic complete result/table case remain unchanged
compatibility.versions: Legacy v1 proposals require legacy accounts; rich v2 proposals require v4 accounts
compatibility.unchanged_fields: Every account field except relations and recipe; relation tables explicitly distinguish event and state kinds

mutation.change: Replace admission situation lookup with events only in an isolated source copy

installed_artifact.environment: Wheel installed into site-packages; probe outside checkout with PYTHONPATH unset
installed_artifact.result: Source and recall construction proposals -> event/state relation admission -> artifact readback; exact API/CLI result and table agreement passed
installed_artifact.example_correction: Save the exact raw proposal bytes used by the API; adding a newline changes response provenance even when parsed claims are identical

independent_review.legacy_comparison: Loaded parent implementation directly; three schemas and five complete receipt/table cases identical
independent_review.response_provenance: Whitespace/CRLF changes alter response hash and invalidate previous receipt while preserving relation identities
independent_review.limits: Reviewer did not repeat full suite, wheel installation or mutation experiment

remaining: Rich identity and structured candidate consumers
Full temporal algebra and causal/reference families
Narrative segment hierarchy; pilot situation part_of is not its replacement
